name: DOC_RAG_FINANCE_BENCHMARK
description: DOC_RAG_FINANCE_BENCHMARK is a retrieval-augmented generation benchmark for finance-focused document question answering, pairing finance documents with queries and ground-truth answers. It is intended to evaluate how well RAG-style systems retrieve relevant financial documents and generate accurate, grounded responses. The benchmark is hosted on Hugging Face and aimed at financial/NLP research on document-grounded QA.
evaluation_method: exact_match and F1 (answer overlap / token-level matching); may also use retrieval metrics for passage selection
reputation: Niche/utility dataset primarily used by practitioners experimenting with RAG in finance; limited broader adoption.
